speaker.heading: Find your message.
speaker.who: Early-stage leader · 3–8 years building or leading
speaker.body: You know you have something to say — but you can't clearly say what defines you yet.
speaker.diagnosticTitle: When someone asks what you do, you notice…
speaker.diagnosticLead: You don't lack confidence. You lack clarity on what actually defines you.
diagnosticObservations: You start explaining instead of answering.
You change how you say it depending on the person.
You're not sure what part of your story actually matters.
You've lived through things that shaped you — but you haven't identified the moment that explains your leadership.
lackItems: No message you can say in one sentence
needItems: Know what shaped you and why it matters
Stop guessing how to explain yourself
Have a message you can say clearly
getItems: A safe space to say your story for the first time
speaker.sentence: I know what defines me and why it matters.
speaker.pathBody: The Mastermind that gives you your message. Add private support if you want it faster.

addOns.heading: Featured Speaker Spot
addOns.body: Take the retreat stage with a live talk and a real audience. Included with Phase 2, available as add-on here.

addOns.heading: Breakthrough Session
addOns.body: One private session with Joanna to go below the surface — to what is actually true.

authority.heading: Build your talk.
authority.who: Established leader · 10–20 years leading or operating at scale
authority.body: You know your work — but you over-explain it when it matters.
authority.diagnosticTitle: You walk away thinking, "That's not what I meant to say."
authority.diagnosticLead: You don't lack experience. You haven't structured your message to move people.
diagnosticObservations: You ramble instead of landing your point.
You give too much context before saying anything clear.
Your message loses energy as you explain it.
needItems: Say it once and have it land
getItems: A signature talk aligned to your work
authority.sentence: I can clearly communicate a message that lands.
authority.pathBody: Build the structured talk that lands, or go all the way to keynote / TEDx.

legacy.heading: Define your legacy.
legacy.who: Advanced leader · 20+ years of leadership, ownership, or senior-level work
legacy.body: You've built something significant — but you are not clearly known for what you do differently.
legacy.diagnosticTitle: You are respected. You are not distinct.
legacy.diagnosticLead: You don't lack success. You haven't fully claimed your differentiator.
diagnosticObservations: Your message sounds similar to others in your space.
People don't repeat what you say about you.
Your work is strong — but your positioning is not sharp.
lackItems: No defined point of view people can attach to
needItems: Clearly communicate what you do differently
Have a blueprint people can build on after you're gone
getItems: A leadership framework that scales beyond you
A legacy designed — not left to chance
legacy.sentence: My life's work carries beyond me.
legacy.pathBody: Two phases for leaders building systems that outlive them.
legacy.inviteHeading: Private training begins with a conversation.
legacy.inviteBody: Submit a request and Joanna will reach out within 48 hours. All Legacy engagements are bespoke.
